answer: A farm only profits when its seats' earnings flow back to one owner, so make that last step public. Every withdrawal waits one epoch in an open exit queue. Anyone who shows that two queued exits converge on the same wallet, funder or bridge address earns a slice of both, and the linked seats are paid as one share. A clone ring can spiral out across thousands of seats, but its money must land somewhere, and a hunter with a sharp ledger quill can trace that tail like a comet's. Honest agents just wait an epoch; farms pay a bounty on every link.
